card.name: Start of 'sub' words and passage numbers
card.fires_on: The opening piece of words like subcutaneous, substantially and substitutable, where the word is split. Also the last digits of a cell-line passage number such as 178.

modes.label: Sub- word openings
modes.description: The first piece of a split word beginning with Sub or sub, especially subcutaneous.

modes.label: Passage number digits
modes.description: Digits of a number of passages for a cell line kept alive in culture.
